Messages.Author: Shawn F. Carnes
Messages.Body:
Bindusara vs. Sudden Reversal
-----------------------------
Tom Wylie, my distinguished predecessor for the newsgroup, originally
made a ruling regarding Sudden Reversal burning a card played by
Bindusara as, "Sudden Reversal can burn cards that have been played with
Bindusara's ability."

Allow me to make a clarification: Sudden Reversal can burn cards that
are being played with Bindusara's ability." This was the original
intent.

--

--Shawn F. Carnes
